coverage.title: Direction distribution
coverage.desc: Groups receiving stations into eight 45° sectors around your station, so you can see which direction and band report you most.
coverage.coarse-hint: These spots only carry the receiver's callsign: bearings come from the DXCC entity centre converted to a 4-character grid, so they are coarse and not the real station position.
coverage.map-desc: Each dot is the centre of the grid square that receiver reported; positions only, no signal strength.

coverage.total.one: {} report counted (spots without a valid locator were skipped)
coverage.total.other: {} reports counted (spots without a valid locator were skipped)

coverage.home-missing: No home grid yet: set your Maidenhead grid in the logbook's station info so directions can be computed.
coverage.empty: None of these reports carries a usable receiver locator.
